item.title: Middle East live: Iran launches first strikes on Israel under new supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei
item.summary: Iran on Monday launched a fresh round of missile strikes against Israel – the first since Iran announced Mojtaba Khamenei as its its new supreme leader. Meanwhile, Israel said it hit targets in central Iran including internal security command centres and missile launch sites. ...

item.title: Who is Mojtaba Khamenei, son and successor to Iran's supreme leader?
item.summary: Iran's Assembly of Experts has named Mojtaba Khamenei to succeed his slain father Ali Khamenei as the country's supreme leader, signalling that hardliners remain firmly in charge in Tehran more than a week into its conflict with the United States and Israel.

item.summary: French Ambassador to Oman Nabil Hajlaoui spoke with FRANCE 24 about the situation in Oman as Iran continued strikes on its regional neighbours in response to US-Israeli attacks starting one week ago.

item.title: Iran : Oil depots hit by Israeli-US strikes
item.summary: Strikes in #Iran hit #oil depots overnight on 7–8 March, killing several people and triggering fires. #Tehran woke under thick #smoke and #toxic rain as the regime has just appointed its new #supreme #leader.
